title: Neural Succession: A Mesoscopic Theory of Invasion, Coexistence, and Stabilization in Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Continual learning is usually studied through mechanisms that preserve old knowledge. We develop Successional Learning Theory (SLT), a mesoscopic account in which the current representation is a resident community, the incoming task is an invader, forgetting is resident displacement, joint retention is coexistence, replay is resident reinforcement, and training moves from establishment toward stabilization. Its empirical coordinate is directional pre-invasion compatibility, measured on the resident model before the incoming task is learned. Across eight experiments, compatibility orders later forgetting on the 20 directed Split-CIFAR-10 transitions (three-repeat r=-0.789, incoming-task cluster 95% CI [-0.90,-0.72], every repeat alone r<=-0.67), forecasts held-out forgetting with 24% lower error than a no-information baseline, and reproduces under controlled MNIST permutations and CIFAR-10 rotations (r=-0.804, -0.718). translated_title: 神经演替：持续学习中入侵、共存与稳定化的介观理论
translated_abstract: 持续学习通常通过保留旧知识的机制来研究。我们提出了演替学习理论，这是一个介观层面的理论框架：将当前表征视为一个“定居群落”，将新来的任务视为“入侵者”，遗忘即定居者的被取代，联合保留即共存，重放即定居者的强化，而训练过程则从建立走向稳定化。该理论的经验坐标是“方向性入侵前兼容性”，它在学习新任务之前于旧模型上测量。在八个实验中，兼容性可以对20个有向Split-CIFAR-10迁移上的后续遗忘进行排序（三次重复的相关系数r=-0.789，新任务聚类的95%置信区间为[-0.90, -0.72]，每次单独重复的r≤-0.67），预测留出遗忘的误差比无信息基线低24%，并在受控的MNIST排列和CIFAR-10旋转下得到复现（r=-0.804和-0.718）。在一个84迁移的[摘要在此处被截断]
tldr: 该论文提出演替学习理论（SLT），借鉴生态学概念将持续学习中的遗忘、共存与重放类比为物种入侵与演替过程，并引入“方向性入侵前兼容性”作为可在学习新任务前测量的指标，用以预测遗忘并指导稳定化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Successional Learning Theory (SLT), an ecological mesoscopic framework that recasts continual learning as invasion, coexistence, and stabilization dynamics, introducing directional pre-invasion compatibility—a measurable pre-learning indicator that predicts future forgetting across diverse benchmarks.
